cases.name: Takara Keshawna Glenn Hightower
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was born in Peoria, IL on January 4, 1988, to Scott E. Scott Sr. and Chinetha Glenn. Ki’s greatest joy & biggest accomplishment was becoming a mother. She enjoyed being pregnant, newborns and baby smells. Her passion was being her children’s #1 fan attending every basketball game, choir concert, and school event she was there cheering them on. She also enjoyed interior decorating, traveling, cooking, listening to music, shopping for the kids, and capturing moments and posing for the camera."
cases.narrative:
He shot and killed her as she was filing a domestic violence complaint against him. As she was speaking to two investigators he pulled out a pistol and started shooting at them. When she tried to run out of the house while holding their baby, he shot her too, killing her and leaving the infant alive.

He also shot and injured one of the two Naval Criminal Investigative Service agents who had been talking to his wife, and they both fired back, hitting him in the stomach. In addition to the infant, the couple’s 3-year-old was in their home at the time. Hightower fled the scene after taking a bullet to the stomach and escaped in his car. Deputies shot and killed him three hours later.
